commands.label: Ask General Question
commands.description: Answer a normal Commander question using reasoning, and route to live data when current facts are required.
commands.rollback_note: No state change; no rollback required.

commands.label: Live Public Research
commands.description: Search current public sources for unstable facts such as deadlines, fees, rules, jobs, news, or route changes.
commands.rollback_note: No state change; cite sources and confidence.

commands.label: Search Kingsmen Knowledge
commands.description: Search Kingsmen doctrine, architecture, laws, pricing, workflows, and safe project memory before answering.
commands.rollback_note: No state change; answer must indicate source basis.

commands.label: Inspect Kingsmen GitHub Repo
commands.description: Inspect approved GitHub repository files, issues, commits, and evidence without exposing private operational material.
commands.rollback_note: No state change; no rollback required.

commands.label: System Status
commands.description: Check approved health endpoints and surface a Commander-readable status summary.
commands.rollback_note: No state change; no rollback required.

commands.label: Validate Build Phase
commands.description: Run or prepare a validator for a Kingsmen phase, then return evidence and repair direction.
commands.rollback_note: Validator should not mutate state; if output files are produced, route through safe file review.

commands.label: Run Web Build
commands.description: Run the web build check and summarize success, failure, and repair path.
commands.rollback_note: No code changes allowed during build command; failed build must return repair notes only.

commands.label: PostgreSQL Read Model Scan
commands.description: Inspect approved read-only operational summaries and table-surface counts without exposing raw private records.

commands.label: Playwright Portal Health Scout
commands.description: Scout an approved public or approved portal page for reachability, blockers, and evidence screenshots.
commands.rollback_note: Scout must not submit forms or bypass blockers; if blocked, generate manual fallback recommendation.

commands.label: Generate Founder Digest
commands.description: Generate a Founder-facing digest covering system health, routes, blockers, queues, finance, and next safe actions.
commands.rollback_note: Generated digest is reviewable and does not change system state.

commands.label: Generate Evidence Pack
commands.description: Generate a reviewable evidence pack from approved evidence entries and source trails.
commands.rollback_note: Evidence pack is a draft until Commander approves external use.

commands.label: Request Commander Approval
commands.description: Create an approval request for a risky command, explaining risk, evidence, expected effect, and rollback path.
commands.rollback_note: If approval is denied, command remains blocked and no action is taken.

commands.label: Send External Message
commands.description: Jarvis must not directly send messages to candidates, public users, schools, employers, funders, or partners as Jarvis.
commands.rollback_note: No action permitted. Use approved communications workflow and Commander-reviewed drafts.
commands.blocked_reason: Jarvis is Commander-only and must not act as public or candidate-facing agent.

commands.label: Make Payment Decision
commands.description: Jarvis must not approve, deny, reverse, refund, or adjudicate payment outcomes alone.
commands.rollback_note: No action permitted. Route to finance review workflow.
commands.blocked_reason: Payment decisions require governed finance workflow and human review.

commands.label: Submit Official Application Silently
commands.description: Jarvis must never silently submit official applications or claim official submission without evidence and approved workflow.
commands.rollback_note: No silent submission permitted. Route through Kingsmen application workflow, consent, evidence, and manual fallback when required.
commands.blocked_reason: Official applications require consent, evidence, and governed Kingsmen workflow.
